notes: τοῦ ὄντος πρὸ τῆς πόλεως: the second article is unrepresented under rule 31, Διός being an expressed head noun, and the supplied subject temple rides with the participle inside the recast relative clause, rule 74 folding a supplied subject onto the verb whose subject it is. Assigning whose temple to the article under rule 102 is the competing reading and is named in the unit's note.
The and before would is a rule 88 juncture on the finite verb it introduces, ἐνέγκας having been converted to the coordinate brought.
SBLGNT.ACT.14.13.v016 is a selected unit whose base reading the ASV translates, so no rule 97 note is owed.
